arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom.core import Check, T

# Test various Check reprs
print('Check():', repr(Check()))
print('Check(type=int):', repr(Check(type=int)))
print('Check(T[\"x\"]):', repr(Check(T['x'])))
print('Check(T[\"x\"], type=str):', repr(Check(T['x'], type=str)))
print('Check(equal_to=\"hello\"):', repr(Check(equal_to='hello')))
print('Check(one_of=(1, 2, 3)):', repr(Check(one_of=(1, 2, 3))))
print('Check(validate=len):', repr(Check(validate=len)))
print('Check(instance_of=int):', repr(Check(instance_of=int)))
print('Check(default=None):', repr(Check(default=None)))
print('Check(T[\"x\"], type=str, equal_to=\"hello\", default=None):', repr(Check(T['x'], type=str, equal_to='hello', default=None)))
"
